source_note_zh: 内容提炼自「TikTok Shop东南亚电商」官方公众号系列文章（官方资讯 / 五国市场洞察 / 大促季备战指南 / 出海航迹商家案例），2026 年 7 月整理。政策与数字以官方最新发布为准。
source_note_en: Distilled from the official "TikTok Shop SEA E-commerce" WeChat account article series (official policies / five-country market insights / mega-sale playbooks / merchant case studies), compiled July 2026. Policies and figures are subject to the latest official releases.

title.zh: 开店指南

tagline.zh: 从入驻到出单的 30 天路线图
tagline.en: A 30-day roadmap from registration to first sale

title.zh: 入驻资质与材料

points.zh: 主体要求：总部在中国内地或香港的企业实体、个体工商户、个人独资企业均可入驻；无经验个体户需走平台定邀通道。
points.en: Entities headquartered in mainland China or Hong Kong qualify — companies, sole proprietors and individual businesses; inexperienced sole proprietors need the platform's invitation channel.

points.zh: 材料：营业执照 + 法人身份证彩色扫描件（四角清晰）；有国内电商/跨境经验可备第三方经验证明截图，有助审核。
points.en: Documents: business licence + colour scan of the legal representative's ID (all four corners visible); screenshots proving prior e-commerce experience help the review.

points.zh: 审核通常 24 小时～7 个工作日；期间先学商家学习中心基础课程。
points.en: Review takes 24 hours to 7 working days — use the wait to finish the Seller Academy basics.

points.zh: 保证金 $90/站点，新商可享 90 天保证金豁免（0 元试运营）。
points.en: Deposit is $90 per market; new merchants get a 90-day deposit waiver (zero-cost trial).

title.zh: 首站怎么选

points.zh: 新手友好：马来西亚（华人占 23%、物流成熟、可用华语内容）与泰国（内容驱动、容易测款）。
points.en: Beginner-friendly: Malaysia (23% ethnic Chinese, mature logistics, Chinese-language content works) and Thailand (content-driven, easy to test products).

points.zh: 潜力增长：越南（增速快、性价比需求旺）、菲律宾（1 亿人口、平均 24 岁、家庭场景强）。
points.en: High-growth: Vietnam (fast growth, value-driven) and the Philippines (100M people, average age 24, strong family scenarios).

points.zh: 高门槛：新加坡（客单价高、利润好，但对品质与服务要求苛刻，适合 2-3 人小团队精细运营）。
points.en: High bar: Singapore (high basket size and margins, but demanding on quality and service — suits a lean 2-3 person team).

title.zh: 必吃透的三大政策红利

points.zh: 0 元试运营：90 天保证金豁免。注意豁免期结算周期从 7 天延长到 30 天，补缴保证金后可恢复 7 天。
points.en: Zero-cost trial: 90-day deposit waiver. Note settlement stretches from 7 to 30 days during the waiver; paying the deposit restores 7-day settlement.

points.zh: 一证多店：一张执照开多个店铺，适合同时测不同品类、不同国家。
points.en: One licence, multiple stores — ideal for testing several categories or countries in parallel.

points.zh: 边境仓：做泰国/越南用广西凭祥边境仓，最快 2-4 天到河内，还享出口退税。
points.en: Border warehouse: for Thailand/Vietnam, ship via the Pingxiang (Guangxi) border warehouse — Hanoi in as fast as 2-4 days, plus export tax rebates.

points.zh: 新商激励：入驻享 30-120 天佣金豁免；入驻 30 天后在后台「任务中心」手动领取商品券（完成首单、GMV $50/$200 等任务）——名额有限、先到先得，设日历提醒别错过。
points.en: New-merchant incentives: 30-120 days commission waiver; from day 30, manually claim product coupons in Task Center (first order, $50/$200 GMV milestones) — limited quota, set a calendar reminder.

title.zh: 开店后先做对这几件事

points.zh: 退货仓必填且国内 + 当地都要有——这是新手最常踩的坑。
points.en: Return warehouses are mandatory in BOTH China and the local market — the single most common rookie mistake.

points.zh: 开启货到付款（COD），符合东南亚主流消费习惯。
points.en: Enable cash-on-delivery (COD) — it's how Southeast Asia prefers to pay.

points.zh: 定价公式：售价 = 产品成本 + 利润 + 平台费用 + 退货损耗 + 达人佣金 + 广告费。漏掉后两项，卖一单亏一单。
points.en: Pricing formula: price = cost + margin + platform fees + returns loss + creator commission + ads. Skip the last two and every sale loses money.

points.zh: 商品图最多 9 张：高清白底主图（利于平台推荐抓取）+ 多场景图。
points.en: Up to 9 product images: a clean white-background hero (helps platform recommendation) plus lifestyle scenes.

points.zh: 尽快接入官方履约仓或免费上门揽收，物流体验直接影响店铺信任。
points.en: Onboard official fulfilment or free pickup early — logistics experience drives store trust.

title.zh: 不同阶段的平台扶持（快消示例）

points.zh: 新商阶段：目标是快速破零，佣金豁免 + 任务奖励，先跑通模型再谈规模。
points.en: New merchants: goal is the first sales — commission waivers + task rewards; prove the model before scaling.

points.zh: 成长商家（日均 GMV $500-2,000）：按月度 GMV 阶梯发放商品折扣券 + 广告金。
points.en: Growth merchants ($500-2,000 daily GMV): tiered product coupons + ad credits pegged to monthly GMV.

points.zh: 头部商家（日均 GMV ≥$2,000）：GMV 环比增 20%+ 得 1-5% 货补（月上限 $10,000）；广告消耗环比增 20%+ 得 5-15% 广告金返点（月上限 $5,000），两项可叠加。
points.en: Top merchants (≥$2,000 daily GMV): 20%+ MoM GMV growth earns 1-5% product subsidy (up to $10,000/mo); 20%+ ad-spend growth earns 5-15% ad rebates (up to $5,000/mo) — stackable.

title.zh: 选品指南

tagline.zh: 先测款、再放量,用数据代替直觉
tagline.en: Test first, scale second — let data replace instinct

title.zh: 选品四原则

points.zh: 性价比 ≠ 低价：消费者先想「我需要」再看价格；每个品类有价位心智区间，摸清刚需比压价更重要。
points.en: Value ≠ cheap: buyers ask "do I need it" before the price; every category has a mental price band — nail the need, not the discount.

points.zh: 找「技术代差」品类：中国已迭代 3-4 代、当地还没认知的产品（如高速吹风机），几乎没有冷启动期。
points.en: Hunt "tech-gap" categories: products China has iterated 3-4 generations on that locals barely know (e.g. high-speed hair dryers) — virtually zero cold start.

points.zh: 挖掘自己的区域产业带优势品（广东箱包、产业带 100 项目），货源和补货能力决定大促能不能接得住。
points.en: Lean on your regional industry-belt advantage (e.g. Guangdong luggage); supply and restock capability decide whether you survive a mega sale.

points.zh: 用 AB 测试找价格带真空：某箱包品牌把国内爆款直接搬去东南亚遇冷，测出 20-40 美元需求真空后调整产品，首周转化率 12%。
points.en: A/B test for price-band gaps: one luggage brand flopped copying its China bestsellers, found a $20-40 vacuum via testing, and hit 12% first-week conversion.

title.zh: 测款方法论

points.zh: 模仿爆款：拆解目标市场同类目高播放视频的开头 3 秒（悬念/对比/痛点），照着拍一条。
points.en: Clone what works: dissect the first 3 seconds of top videos in your category (suspense / contrast / pain point) and shoot your version.

points.zh: 小额投流测 3-5 条不同风格视频，完播率 >40% 的就是潜力爆品信号。
points.en: Micro-budget boost 3-5 different-style videos; >40% completion rate signals a potential winner.

points.zh: 从「展示产品」转向「展示产品如何解决问题/带来快乐」——手机配件商家靠这一转变把播放量和订单一起拉起来。
points.en: Shift from "showing the product" to "showing how it solves a problem or sparks joy" — a phone-accessory seller turned views and orders around with exactly this.

points.zh: 数据复盘口诀：完播率高转化低 → 查详情页和价格；转化高完播低 → 改视频开头。
points.en: Diagnosis rule: high completion + low conversion → fix the listing/price; high conversion + low completion → fix the video hook.

title.zh: 商品页优化(标题/主图/详情)

points.zh: 标题四要素：核心关键词 1-5 个（精准优于模糊，如 luggage 优于 bag）+ 属性词 0-3 个（材质/颜色/风格）+ 人群词 1 个 + 品牌词（有授权才写）。
points.en: Title = 1-5 core keywords (precise beats generic: 'luggage' over 'bag') + 0-3 attribute words (material/colour/style) + 1 audience word + brand word (only if licensed).

points.zh: 主图 1:1、≥600×600、商品占画面 2/3、淡色纯背景、无阴影无粗糙抠图。
points.en: Hero image: 1:1, ≥600×600px, product fills ~2/3, plain light background, no shadows or rough cutouts.

points.zh: 详情页顺序：亮点 → 细节 → 保障；服饰配尺码表，美妆/食品列成分、有效期、认证。
points.en: Detail page order: highlights → specifics → guarantees; size charts for apparel, ingredients/expiry/certifications for beauty & food.

points.zh: 违规红线：禁用「最/第一/绝对」；无客观证据不得放前后对比图或宣称疗效——违规会被限流。
points.en: Red lines: no superlatives ('best/No.1/absolute'); no before-after images or medical-style claims without evidence — violations throttle your reach.

points.zh: 把差评当金矿：每个差评背后都是一个群体用户的痛点,也是下一个卖点。
points.en: Mine bad reviews: every 1-star review is a segment-level pain point — and your next selling point.

title.zh: 五国市场洞察

tagline.zh: 一国一策:画像、热销品类与打法
tagline.en: One playbook per country: profile, hot categories, tactics

title.zh: 🇲🇾 马来西亚 — 华语友好,健康为王

points.zh: 画像：华裔占 23.2%,华语短视频/直播可直接触达；消费理性,下单前详细比价,重性价比而非低价。
points.en: Profile: 23.2% ethnic Chinese — Mandarin content reaches them directly; rational shoppers who compare specs and prices, valuing worth over cheapness.

points.zh: 热销：成分党美妆（神经酰胺/维C/积雪草,保湿抗氧提亮）、保健食品、智能小家电、穆斯林时尚。
points.en: Hot: ingredient-led beauty (ceramide/vitamin C/centella; hydration, antioxidant, brightening), health supplements, smart small appliances, modest (Muslim) fashion.

points.zh: 打法：健康是溢价关键词——「是否有益健康」已成东南亚消费者愿付更高价的第一原因之一；一年过四个年（春节/开斋节/屠妖节/圣诞),节点提前备货。
points.en: Tactics: health justifies premium pricing — it's a top reason SEA consumers pay more; Malaysia celebrates four new years (CNY, Hari Raya, Deepavali, Christmas) — stock up ahead of each.

title.zh: 🇹🇭 泰国 — 直播沃土,及时行乐

points.zh: 画像：直播产业发达（娱播基因）,电商用户 2025 年预计 2,653 万；储蓄率低、发薪日消费,价格敏感度较低,产品打动人就愿意付高客单。
points.en: Profile: mature livestream culture (entertainment-streaming roots), ~26.5M e-commerce users by 2025; low savings, payday-driven spending, low price sensitivity — win their interest and they pay up.

points.zh: 热销：母婴（「得母婴者得东南亚」）、汽车配饰（宁可无房必须有车）、宠物用品、高颜值 3C（多彩耳机/音箱）、鞋包（幸运色文化,单款多色更好卖）、露营钓鱼装备。
points.en: Hot: mother & baby ('win mums, win SEA'), car accessories ('a car before a house'), pet supplies, colourful 3C gadgets, shoes & bags (lucky-colour culture — multi-colour variants sell), camping & fishing gear.

points.zh: 打法：重仪式感和外在打扮,时尚品类客单可上探；INS 风、Y2K、韩国爱豆同款是女装热搜词。
points.en: Tactics: strong dress-up culture supports higher fashion prices; 'Insta-style', Y2K and K-idol dupes are top womenswear search terms.

title.zh: 🇻🇳 越南 — 人口破亿,摩托王国

points.zh: 画像：平均年龄 29 岁,70% 在 35 岁以下；女性劳动参与率 74%（全球前列）,女性购买力持续释放；Z 世代对直播电商接受度极高。
points.en: Profile: average age 29, 70% under 35; 74% female labour participation (world-leading) unlocking female buying power; Gen-Z embraces live commerce.

points.zh: 热销：汽摩配件（摩托占机动车 85%+,绝对刚需）、防雨防潮（5-9 月雨季:除湿机/烘干机/防潮包）、防晒美白护肤、母婴用品。
points.en: Hot: motorbike parts & accessories (85%+ of vehicles — hard demand), rain/damp-proofing (May-Sep monsoon: dehumidifiers, dryers, dry bags), sun-care & brightening skincare, mother & baby.

points.zh: 打法：跟着气候卖货——雨季与强紫外线是两条常年主线；儿童商品换新快、单价低、试错成本小,适合跨境起步。
points.en: Tactics: sell with the climate — monsoon and strong UV are two evergreen storylines; kids' goods refresh fast at low prices, ideal for cross-border starters.

title.zh: 🇵🇭 菲律宾 — 最年轻的市场,英语最好

points.zh: 画像：1 亿+人口,平均 24-25 岁,日均上网 8 小时；半月薪制,每月 15 日和月末发薪日是固定爆单节点；习惯超前消费。
points.en: Profile: 100M+ people averaging 24-25 years old, 8 hours online daily; paid twice monthly — the 15th and month-end paydays are guaranteed sales spikes; spend-forward culture.

points.zh: 热销：女装（注意尺码偏大）、家居收纳/餐厨（长尾潜力大）、母婴童装（竞争小易冷启）、圣诞图案商品需求旺。
points.en: Hot: womenswear (size up!), home storage & kitchenware (long-tail potential), mother-baby & kidswear (low competition, easy cold start), Christmas-motif goods.

points.zh: 打法：本地供应链和品牌稀缺——用中国供应链做本地头部品牌的机会窗口；英语普及率亚洲第一,内容制作门槛低。
points.en: Tactics: weak local supply chains and brands = a window to build local category leaders with Chinese supply; Asia's best English makes content production cheap.

title.zh: 🇸🇬 新加坡 — 小而美,高客单

points.zh: 画像：人均 GDP 全球最前列,互联网普及 98%,58%+ 居民网购；价格敏感度低,愿为品质和品牌付溢价。
points.en: Profile: world-top GDP per capita, 98% internet penetration, 58%+ shop online; low price sensitivity — happily pays for quality and brand.

points.zh: 热销：消费电子（手机配件/智能设备）、时尚美容（中高端可行,黑白灰职场风）、进口日用品（与本地品牌价差大:吸水抹布/清洁用品）、国产玩具与智能小家电。
points.en: Hot: consumer electronics (phone accessories, smart devices), fashion & beauty (mid-to-high end works; monochrome office style), imported daily goods (big price gap vs local brands: cloths, cleaning), Chinese toys & smart appliances.

points.zh: 打法：适合 2-3 人小团队精细运营,几个月可做到日销百单；跨境店用全球商品上架,在新加坡开播还能同时触达其他国家用户。
points.en: Tactics: suits a lean 2-3 person team — day-100-orders within months is achievable; with global listings, a Singapore livestream also reaches users in other markets.

title.zh: 大促与内容打法

tagline.zh: 直播 + 达人 + 价格力 = 爆发公式
tagline.en: Livestream + creators + price power = the breakout formula

title.zh: 大促三段式节奏

points.zh: 活动前（蓄水）：储备爆款与库存、优化关键词、短视频预热引流、提前 3-7 天给达人寄新品锁排期。
points.en: Before (build-up): stock winners, tune keywords, warm up with short videos, ship samples and lock creator slots 3-7 days ahead.

points.zh: 活动期（放大）：秒杀 + 平台券承接转化,直播打榜 + 达人带货 + 广告对已验证爆款集中放量。
points.en: During (amplify): flash sales + platform coupons convert; live leaderboards + creator selling + ads concentrate spend on proven winners.

points.zh: 活动后（沉淀）：复盘哪些商品可持续放量、哪些内容可复用,形成「准备-放大-沉淀」循环。
points.en: After (consolidate): review which products can keep scaling and which content is reusable — a prepare-amplify-consolidate loop.

points.zh: 实证：12.12 当天东南亚跨境整体 GMV 接近翻倍,马来 +138%、新加坡 +127%；泰马直播 GMV 增长超 170%。
points.en: Proof: on 12.12 cross-border GMV nearly doubled — Malaysia +138%, Singapore +127%; livestream GMV grew 170%+ in Thailand and Malaysia.

title.zh: 直播运营要点

points.zh: 自播（日常转化、复购沉淀）+ 达人直播（大促集中放量）联动,形成「达人引流—自播承接—复购沉淀」正循环。
points.en: Pair self-run streams (daily conversion, repeat buyers) with creator streams (sale-day volume): creators pull traffic, your stream catches it, repeat purchases compound.

points.zh: 语言优先级：本地语言 > 英语 > 中文（仅部分市场）；中文直播同样有违禁词风险,需提前规避。
points.en: Language order: local language > English > Chinese (select markets only); banned-word rules apply even to Chinese streams.

points.zh: 持续稳定开播比单场爆发更容易拿平台流量——先保底自播,稳定时长再加码。
points.en: Consistent scheduled streaming earns more platform traffic than one-off spikes — secure a baseline cadence first, then extend hours.

points.zh: 话术要有紧迫感和门槛：「今天 99 减 20,活动结束立刻恢复原价」优于「马上送福利」。
points.en: Scripts need urgency and stakes: "$20 off $99 today only — price restores when the stream ends" beats a vague "freebies coming up".

points.zh: 开播前 5-10 分钟高效成交循环：品牌自我介绍 → 当日主推与福利 → 场景化卖点演示（纸尿裤现场测吸水、和硬币比厚度）→ 10-15 分钟限时促销。
points.en: First 5-10 minutes conversion loop: brand intro → today's hero product & perks → scenario demos (test the nappy's absorbency live, compare thickness to a coin) → a 10-15 minute flash offer.

points.zh: 冷启工具：直播流量券、抽奖闪卡、赠品、免邮,二次唤醒已被种草的用户。
points.en: Cold-start tools: live traffic vouchers, lucky-draw cards, gifts and free shipping re-activate users already seeded by your content.

title.zh: 节日与固定爆单节点

points.zh: 斋月（约 2 月底-3 月,马来/印尼）：传统服饰、特色食品、礼品爆发；用 #BajuRaya #Recipes #Bazaar 等标签做场景内容。
points.en: Ramadan (late Feb-Mar, Malaysia/Indonesia): traditional wear, festive food and gifts surge; ride hashtags like #BajuRaya #Recipes #Bazaar.

points.zh: 发薪日（菲律宾每月 15 日和月末,泰国发薪周末）：平台有对应 Payday 促销,大促外的稳定增量,实测比前日增长 20-30%。
points.en: Paydays (15th & month-end in the Philippines, payday weekends in Thailand): platform runs Payday sales — a steady +20-30% vs the previous day.

points.zh: Double Day（1.1/2.2…12.12）与地区节日（春节/宋干节/圣诞）全年排布,商家日历要提前排到季度。
points.en: Double Days (1.1 through 12.12) plus regional festivals (CNY, Songkran, Christmas) run all year — plan your calendar a quarter ahead.

points.zh: 大促日常之外,常规活动同样有量：后台「活动中心」报名秒杀/频道活动/限时热销,任务中心每天领免费券和加热权益。
points.en: Between sales, everyday campaigns still deliver: join flash/channel/hot-deal events in Campaign Center, and claim free coupons & boosts daily in Task Center.

title.zh: 广告与放大

points.zh: 先内容后广告：对已经跑出数据的潜力视频用 Product GMV Max / Live GMV Max 追投,自动优化放大。
points.en: Content first, ads second: put Product GMV Max / Live GMV Max behind videos that already show traction — they auto-optimise the scale-up.

points.zh: AIGC 可辅助创意,但不得夸大效果、伪造体验或编造故事。
points.en: AIGC may assist creative work, but never exaggerate results, fake experiences or fabricate stories.

points.zh: 跨境店 + 全球商品上架后,单场直播可多国同步触达（如新加坡开播覆盖周边市场）。
points.en: With a cross-border store and global listings, one stream reaches multiple markets at once (e.g. a Singapore stream covers neighbours).

title.zh: 标杆案例拆解

tagline.zh: 四个真实商家,四套可复制打法
tagline.en: Four real merchants, four replicable playbooks

title.zh: Yoole 高速吹风机 — 2 年做到月 GMV $100 万
title.en: Yoole hair dryers — $1M monthly GMV in 2 years

points.zh: 选品逻辑：押注「技术代差」——当地还在用传统吹风机,中国技术已迭代三四代,产品一推出几乎没有冷启动期,首月即售 1000-2000 台（约 $10 万）。
points.en: Selection: bet on the tech gap — locals used legacy dryers while China was 3-4 generations ahead; launch month did 1,000-2,000 units (~$100K) with virtually no cold start.

points.zh: 各国电路标准和认证不同,国内检测合格≠当地可用；出现异常立即召回调整,守住口碑。
points.en: Electrical standards and certifications differ per country — passing China labs ≠ local compliance; they recalled and fixed issues immediately to protect reputation.

points.zh: 达人打法：KOL+KOC 大规模铺内容制造声量,再用泰国选美冠军代言 + 文旅局宋干节活动建立本地信任。
points.en: Creator play: mass KOL+KOC content for awareness, then a Thai beauty-queen ambassador and a Songkran event with the tourism board to build local trust.

points.zh: 教训：首波爆单后断货撞上春节,前期营销素材全部作废——旺季前备货和供应链弹性是生死线。
points.en: Hard lesson: a stockout after the first surge hit Chinese New Year and wasted all momentum — pre-season inventory and supply-chain slack are life-or-death.

title.zh: Mesuca 箱包 — 单场直播 $18 万

points.zh: 国内爆款直接搬 = 失败;AB 测试发现 20-40 美元价格带真空,改推校园风 IP 背包与度假联名旅行箱,首周转化率 12%。
points.en: Copy-pasting China bestsellers flopped; A/B tests exposed a $20-40 price vacuum — campus-style IP backpacks and vacation-branded cases hit 12% first-week conversion.

points.zh: 铁三角团队：内容组（选品/脚本）+ 运营组（投流/数据）+ 直播组（场景化带货）,总部供应链中台支撑。
points.en: Iron-triangle team: content (selection/scripts) + operations (ads/data) + livestream (scenario selling), backed by an HQ supply-chain middle office.

points.zh: 节奏：先「达人分销+短视频种草」快速起量（占销量 70%）,再自建本土直播团队做到日均 8 小时自播,与泰国顶流主播专场创下 $18 万纪录。
points.en: Sequence: creator distribution + short-video seeding first (70% of sales), then a local team streaming 8h/day — a special with Thailand's top host set the $180K record.

points.zh: 物流：自有海外仓 + 官方认证仓组合,发货时效和成本双优。
points.en: Logistics: own overseas warehouse + official certified warehouse — faster delivery at lower cost.

title.zh: 奇亚娜箱包 — 单日订单破万
title.en: Qiyana luggage — 10,000+ orders in a day

points.zh: 月订单 70-80% 来自达人推广:「商品链接只是媒介,一定要靠达人把它推出去」。
points.en: 70-80% of monthly orders come via creators: "the product link is just a medium — creators are what push it out."

points.zh: 冷启期主动调高佣金让利,吸引大批达人挂车,引爆第一个爆款云朵包。
points.en: In cold start they raised commissions deliberately, attracting a wave of creators whose videos ignited the first hit (the 'cloud bag').

points.zh: 试错教训：一个月狂发 2000 份样品只筛出 6-7 个可用达人 → 改用联盟后台数据筛选（月出单量、带货 GMV、履约率、场观）,效率天差地别。
points.en: Lesson: blasting 2,000 samples in a month yielded 6-7 usable creators → switching to affiliate-backend data (monthly orders, GMV, fulfilment rate, viewers) changed everything.

points.zh: 长期主义：直播后必与达人复盘,节假日问候,把达人处成并肩作战的朋友——换来更深更久的合作。
points.en: Long-termism: post-stream reviews with creators, holiday check-ins — treat them as comrades, and the partnerships deepen and last.

points.zh: 本地达人比商家更懂本地内容:「达人坐在车里随意口播一条都能火」,专业的事交给专业的人。
points.en: Local creators understand local content better than you: "a casual talking-head video shot in a car can blow up" — delegate content to the pros.

title.zh: Makuku 母婴 — 菲律宾半年增长 900%
title.en: Makuku mother & baby — 900% growth in 6 months (PH)

points.zh: 先种草后直播：每月建联 500 达人、每人 4 条视频,把话题曝光从 2000 万做到 1 亿,再开播把曝光转成 GMV。
points.en: Seed before streaming: 500 creator deals a month, 4 videos each, lifting hashtag exposure from 20M to 100M — then livestreams converted it to GMV.

points.zh: 达人不够就跨赛道找：母婴达人稀缺时,合作美妆/好物测评博主——粉丝画像（18-34 女性）高度重合即可。
points.en: When niche creators run out, cross categories: beauty and product-review creators share the 18-34 female audience — overlap matters more than the label.

points.zh: 预算有限的组合：全佣达人跑量 + 少量头部达人建信任,头部素材一条剪多条放大效益。
points.en: Tight-budget combo: full-commission creators for volume + a few top creators for trust, re-cutting their footage into multiple videos.

points.zh: 大促蓄水：提前 3-5 天预热短视频,消费者会等到大促集中下单;Double Day 环比 +50%,发薪日 +20-30%,品牌日单月 GMV 破百万人民币。
points.en: Sale build-up: tease with videos 3-5 days early — shoppers wait and buy in bulk; Double Day +50%, payday +20-30%, and a Brand Day month broke ¥1M GMV.

points.zh: 直播团队是冷启关键：主播优选有直播/主持经验者并系统培训;前 5-10 分钟必须高效成交,不能拖。
points.en: The live team decides cold starts: hire hosts with streaming/MC experience and train them; the first 5-10 minutes must convert — no warm-up drift.
